section: Multinational bank, London Canary Wharf HQ: meeting rooms and AV technology AVI-SPL UK integrated (Skype for Business era)
body:
This case study describes how AVI-SPL UK equipped a multinational bank's new London headquarters with collaboration technology. Important qualifier: it is proof from an older platform generation. The standard rooms ran on the Skype for Business Platform, so it shows AVI-SPL's approach and scale and is not a current platform reference.

**The customer and project**
- The bank is not named. It is described as one of Europe's leading financial services groups, founded over 100 years ago. The case study labels it a Banking Services Firm in London.
- The bank was moving circa 3,000 employees from three existing London offices to a new headquarters in Canary Wharf.
- AVI-SPL's task was to equip the headquarters so staff could collaborate with each other and with partners and clients.
- James Gilham, senior project manager for AVI-SPL, said the project was all about user experience and delivering a high level of staff satisfaction.
- Solution brands listed: Christie, Cisco, Crestron, Sharp NEC Display Solutions.

**How the design was reached**
AVI-SPL UK spent a period of a year working alongside the client and its consultant, macom Group, on AV design and integration for the Bank Street building, the new UK headquarters. The work involved a series of workshops, numerous feedback sessions and a proof-of-concept room set up in one of the existing buildings.

**What was installed**
- There are 150 private client meeting rooms and internal meeting spaces in the building. Each is fitted with an HP Slice conferencing system, which uses the Skype for Business Platform, and a Sharp NEC Display Solutions C-Series display. Slice lets people start calls, add attendees and share content.
- These rooms also have a Crestron MD switcher, for choosing which content goes to the display, and a Pulse Origin wireless sharing device for sharing from a personal device.
- Divisible spaces on multiple floors can be reconfigured by staff to suit the meeting.
- The fifth floor has two large divisible boardrooms, each with two 98” Sharp NEC Display Solutions C-Series displays for video calls and presentations. Both have a Cisco camera-tracking system that works with the room microphones to focus on the participant at each seat. Two Crestron TSW touch panels control video conferencing and presentation systems, plus lighting and blinds.
- Customer meeting spaces on the fifth floor have a Sharp NEC Display Solutions C-series display, a Cisco Webex video conferencing system, a Pulse Origin wireless sharing device and a Crestron HDMI switcher for wired and wireless devices.
- A Christie video wall in reception shows news updates, welcome messages, employee information and financial service updates, meeting a key client objective of capturing the attention of everyone entering.

**When to use this**
Use it for questions about AVI-SPL's experience with large bank headquarters moves, proof-of-concept rooms, or boardroom and client-suite design, always noting the older platform.

**Not stated in this source**: project cost and the year of the project.
